## Mapped classes

No class is mapped in the pilot jurisdictions (TX, WA and PA (state), Lewis County WA (county environmental health), Philadelphia Water Department (municipal utility)). The role's targets below are what a jurisdiction would crosswalk its own class specification against.

## Competency targets by role level (agent draft)

- Conduct prescribed fire from burn planning through ignition, holding and evaluation — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Design fuels treatments that reduce wildfire hazard and verify their effects in the field — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Manage risk in uncontrolled field environments — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Plan smoke management for prescribed and managed fire within air quality requirements — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Communicate environmental and health risks under uncertainty — journey L2, senior L2, lead L3
- Lead field crews and transfer field judgment to novices — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Predict fire behaviour from fuels, weather and topography for operations and planning — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Apply safety practices and stop-work authority across field, facility and incident settings — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
